title: Location 2 Hive Mall

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Hey, you're here! The tour is really flying now. And you were there from the very start.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, you're here! The tour is really flying now. And you were there from the very start.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It's wild to think that the first speech at Meridian was just a few days ago. It feels like a million years! We've come so far.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's wild to think that the first speech at Meridian was just a few days ago. It feels like a million years! We've come so far.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It's like everything is kinda the same, but different? You know. Everything seems brighter, like I've washed my eyeballs in a bowl of sunshine this morning.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's like everything is kinda the same, but different? You know. Everything seems brighter, like I've washed my eyeballs in a bowl of sunshine this morning.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It's wild how much hope, purpose and hard work can adjust your destiny and create a road for peace and freedom and joy. I can't wait to share my new mindset with people.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's wild how much hope, purpose and hard work can adjust your destiny and create a road for peace and freedom and joy. I can't wait to share my new mindset with people.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: The city has an energy field - a life force, and today, it flows through my veins. My blood is charged with hope and rapture and adulation. And some Senatrepine to take the edge of the, you know, feelings of doom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The city has an energy field - a life force, and today, it flows through my veins. My blood is charged with hope and rapture and adulation. And some Senatrepine to take the edge of the, you know, feelings of doom.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I'd bung you a skwirp, but I took the whole vial. The time is now!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd bung you a skwirp, but I took the whole vial. The time is now!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I told you before, I don't need someone to nay all my says!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I told you before, I don't need someone to nay all my says!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Same drill as before! Our classic of call-and-response set up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Same drill as before! Our classic of call-and-response set up.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Just let your words free. I am so ready for this today! Olive Nek speaking tour, part two. HIVE MALL! Let's go! ...You ready?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just let your words free. I am so ready for this today! Olive Nek speaking tour, part two. HIVE MALL! Let's go! ...You ready?

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Remember, after every statement I make, you shout out... something. Like "YEAH!" or "PREACH!" or "WE WON'T BE SILENCED!" or "OLIVE NEK IS GOD!"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Remember, after every statement I make, you shout out... something. Like "YEAH!" or "PREACH!" or "WE WON'T BE SILENCED!" or "OLIVE NEK IS GOD!"

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: THE FIRE IS SPREADING. THE FLAMES WILL SOON SPARK EMBERS LONG DORMANT! AS WE GAIN MOMENTUM, WATCH THE CORPORATE CURS SCUTTLE TO THEIR HOLES FOR SHELTER!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THE FIRE IS SPREADING. THE FLAMES WILL SOON SPARK EMBERS LONG DORMANT! AS WE GAIN MOMENTUM, WATCH THE CORPORATE CURS SCUTTLE TO THEIR HOLES FOR SHELTER!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Alright, that's Hive Mall done and the tour rolls on! Hey, these talks are much easier to do when you're high as a fucking kite. I should remember that...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, that's Hive Mall done and the tour rolls on! Hey, these talks are much easier to do when you're high as a fucking kite. I should remember that...

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR SUPPORT TODAY. IT WON'T BE FORGOTTEN! I'LL SEE YOU ALL FOR THE NEXT LEG OF THE TOUR AT HELIX MONUMENTAL. LET'S MARCH ON!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: THANK YOU EVERYONE FOR YOUR SUPPORT TODAY. IT WON'T BE FORGOTTEN! I'LL SEE YOU ALL FOR THE NEXT LEG OF THE TOUR AT HELIX MONUMENTAL. LET'S MARCH ON!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: COMPANIONS! UNDER MY LEADERSHIP, OUR REVOLUTION GAINS MOVEMENT - NO MATTER WHAT MAGREADY AND DELBERT AND HIS CRONIES IN THE DISCIPLINARY PANEL OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE MAY SAY!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: COMPANIONS! UNDER MY LEADERSHIP, OUR REVOLUTION GAINS MOVEMENT - NO MATTER WHAT MAGREADY AND DELBERT AND HIS CRONIES IN THE DISCIPLINARY PANEL OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE MAY SAY!

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: PEOPLE OF HIVE MALL, IT'S TIME TO CAST OFF THE SHACKLES OF CORPORATE OPPRESSION AND EMBRACE A NEW WAY. A BETTER WAY.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: PEOPLE OF HIVE MALL, IT'S TIME TO CAST OFF THE SHACKLES OF CORPORATE OPPRESSION AND EMBRACE A NEW WAY. A BETTER WAY.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: ...that's not really the key part to focus on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...that's not really the key part to focus on.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: ...who are you, my editor? Come on man! Can you not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...who are you, my editor? Come on man! Can you not?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure that's such a good plan.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure that's such a good plan.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm not sure that's such a good plan.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm not sure that's such a good plan.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Like I said, I'll shout out my OWN response.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like I said, I'll shout out my OWN response.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Like I said, I'll shout out my OWN response.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Like I said, I'll shout out my OWN response.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You seem much more positive today.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You seem much more positive today.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You seem much more positive today.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You seem much more positive today.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't think I can continue this, Olive. Sorry!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't think I can continue this, Olive. Sorry!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't think I can continue this, Olive. Sorry!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't think I can continue this, Olive. Sorry!
